title: Interpretation 00-16 (Spokane County): 'firm and stable' accessible surfaces for a public park using gravel and grass
jurisdiction: Washington State, requested by Spokane County (comparative test only; not Alberta)

facts.text: Document type: State Building Code Council interpretation no. 00-16, one page; requester Spokane County.

Project as described: a public park project proposes gravel and grass as the surface materials for accessible parking stalls and for exterior accessible routes connecting structures and site facilities.
Question 1 asks which materials or methods satisfy 'firm and stable' surfaces for public park routes in urban, suburban or rural settings; Question 2 asks the same for accessible parking.
